info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Underwriting Management API
info.description: The Underwriting Management API facilitates seamless integration of underwriting processes within banking sales operations. This endpoint enables the initiation of underwriting requests, enabling financial institutions to evaluate and manage risk assessments effectively. By streamlining data collection and analysis, the API supports underwriters in making informed decisions. Typical consumers include banking institutions and financial service providers looking to enhance their underwriting workflows. Leverage this API to expedite underwriting submissions and enhance customer response times.

post.summary: Initiate the underwriting process for a sale.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to start the underwriting process for a specific sale. It collects necessary details to evaluate the risk and financial aspects involved in the sale transaction. Use this API call to ensure all underwriting data is received and processed efficiently.
